item.title: Karnataka Finds Up to 31.2% Ethanol in Petrol, Puts Annual Consumer Burden at Rs 1.01 Lakh Crore
item.description: Karnataka's fuel quality tests have found ethanol content exceeding the mandated E20 limit in 11 of 14 petrol samples, with the highest concentration at 31.2%. The State government has raised concerns over vehicle compatibility, reduced mileage and repair costs, demanding greater transparency, consumer compensation and stricter monitoring.
item.dc:creator: Rajasree Singh

item.title: FAO Food Price Index Falls 1.2% in October as Cereal, Dairy and Meat Prices Decline
item.description: The FAO Food Price Index declined 1.2% month-on-month to 133.9 points in October 2026, driven by lower cereal, dairy and meat prices. Sugar prices rose 6.6% to their highest level since December 2024, while vegetable oil prices edged up marginally amid firm global demand.
item.dc:creator: Rajasree Singh

item.title: Godrej Agrovet Q2 Revenue Rises 17%, Net Profit Jumps 22% to Rs 103 Crore
item.description: Godrej Agrovet reported a 17% year-on-year increase in consolidated revenue to Rs 2,995 crore in Q2 FY27. Net profit rose 22% to Rs 103 crore, while EBITDA remained flat at Rs 222 crore amid input cost pressures and weather-related challenges.
item.dc:creator: Rajasree Singh
